label: MC-001
note: Real NullReferenceException risk: the query is materialized with ToListAsync first, then plain C# dereferences result.Customer.Name where Customer is a nullable navigation property that EF may not have loaded, causing NRE at runtime.

known_true_positive.title: NullReferenceException: Customer navigation not loaded before dereference
known_true_positive.why_it_matters: The orders are materialized with ToListAsync without Include(o => o.Customer), so with lazy loading off Customer is null and o.Customer.Name throws for every order the handler returns.
